nodes.name: Append to Google Sheets - configure then enable

parameters.content:
## Manual paid API pilot
Review inputs and current credit rules before one request. Select your own Header Auth credential; no key belongs in this JSON. Leave Sheets disabled while checking the returned supplier object and mapped rows. Configure a scratch destination using the CSV headings before enabling writes. No automatic retry, schedule or pagination. In-run deduplication is not persistent delivery state. seenVideoIds is local supplied history and is not sent to the API. The companion SQLite helper is separate, not connected automatically.
